structure.en: I've taken a liking to you

patterns.name: 〜が気に入る
patterns.explanation: きにいる is a set phrase, word for word 'to go into one's feelings', used for coming to like something. きに　いった = 'I've taken a liking to you'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end of a sentence gives it a soft, womanly tone. いったわ = 'I've come to like you'.
